name: Postman
label: Postman API
description: Postman API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://learning.postman.com/docs/developer/postman-api/authentication. Operations: collection_get, collection_run, environment_get, environment_update, monitor_run, mock_get. Auth secret api_key is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: collection_get | collection_run | environment_get | environment_update | monitor_run | mock_get. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'collection_get'.

schema.label: environment
schema.description: Environment envelope escape hatch for environment_update. Purpose fields name/values merge in via bodyMap. Example: {"values":[{"key":"baseUrl","value":"https://api.example.com"}]}.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Environment name on environment_update. Nested as environment.name. Example: Staging.

schema.label: values
schema.description: Environment values on environment_update. Nested as environment.values. Example: [{"key":"token","value":"x","enabled":true,"type":"secret"}].

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: collection_get, collection_run, environment_get, environment_update, monitor_run, mock_get. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).
